item.title: Cabinet Dictatorship
item.description: Cabinet Dictatorship Cabinet dictatorship, in the interwar diagnosis of how Britain was actually governed, was the concentration of real power in a Cabinet sustained by rigid party organisation, so that the House of Commons became little more than a registering machine for decisions taken elsewhere.
